ruleDefinitions.name: AspNetCompiler Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "aspnet_compiler.exe" which can be abused to compile and execute C# code.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\Framework\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\Framework64\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\FrameworkArm\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\FrameworkArm64\\\\.*")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\aspnet\\_compiler\\\.exe$"))
